description: Election Commission - Declare that Kariyawasam Dewarakkottage Janaka Prasanna of the Bentota Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his Office of member - Declare that Mr. Milvaganam Paramanadan of the Talawakelle urban Council has Vacated his Office of member
reasoning: This gazette contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of local government bodies (Bentota Pradeshiya Sabha and Talawakelle Lindula Urban Council) due to ceasing membership in their respective political parties. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including vacating of offices.
